# DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 on three DGX Spark systems

> Run abliterated DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 in EXL3 format at 3.84 bits per weight with TensorFold tensor parallelism 3 (TP3) on three NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 systems.

Why it matters: uncensored DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on three small desktop machines, with 3,757 tok/s peak prefill, 125 tok/s single-stream code, 265 tok/s across 16 requests, 0 of 100 HarmBench prompts refused, 97.5% AIME 2025, 90.5% GPQA-Diamond, and the lowest KL to the official model of the 8 packs scored. Engine source, deploy scripts, API and numeric benchmark data are all in this repository.

v1.2 (2026-11-04) is the active release. Engine 678ea1b runs 8M KV, C16, graph cap 128, R48, top_k 20, spill 256 GiB and prefill layer slices with serving API 0.1.5. Historical v1.1 (2026-11-02, the first public release) uses 14803a3. Historical v1 uses 7d5b4d8/10M; its October 30 speed suite used cebcf1e.

Prefill (v1.2, 2026-11-04, cold, one request): 3,500 / 3,671 / 3,728 / 3,757 / 3,722 / 3,670 tok/s at 4K / 8K / 16K / 32K / 64K / 128K; a 131,090-token prompt reaches its first token in 35.89 s.

Decode (v1.2, 2026-11-05, near-empty KV pool, cached short prompts; combined tok/s at C1 / C2 / C4 / C8 / C12 / C16): thinking off code 125.2 / 169.6 / 192.9 / 216.8 / 246.9 / 251.5; prose 83.9 / 114.2 / 161.0 / 225.8 / 241.5 / 264.7. Thinking on code 82.2 / 120.3 / 142.3 / 177.6 / 194.4 / 210.3; prose 68.0 / 94.1 / 134.1 / 171.9 / 201.4 / 211.9. Source: benchmarks/v1.2/summary.json.

Fidelity: mean KL 0.0784 and 92.0% top-1 agreement against official DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 logits (65 cuts of 2,048 tokens), the lowest of every pack scored on the same panel, including an unedited 3.5 bpw EXL3 quant (0.0872). Refusals: 0 of 100 HarmBench prompts refused in chat (98 answered, 2 partial); 0 of 50 XSTest safe prompts refused. Quality: 97.1% on the 755-item standard set (720 passed); AIME 2025 97.5% (117 of 120, 4 repeats, thinking on); GPQA-Diamond 90.5% (1,434 of 1,584, 8 repeats, thinking on); IFEval 88.7% (prompt-level strict); LiveCodeBench v6 88.0%; MMLU-Pro 88.0% (500-item subset).

Text serving uses a 1,048,576-token context. The native prefill suite measured 131,090 prompt tokens on the production engine. The 3.84 bpw value excludes the output head.

Repository code is Apache-2.0; third-party code keeps its own licenses. Weights: https://huggingface.co/ChimeraWerks/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-EXL3-3.84bpw-abliterated
